name: Comel Hatchback
summary: A fictional five-seat small hatchback from KL Rush’s street traffic, assembled with its wheels where the game mounts them.
notes: Geometry as it ships in KL Rush, compressed for the web (meshopt geometry, KTX2 textures). The game paints and shades its cars in code; here that look is rebuilt as standard glTF materials, without the game’s dirt, dust and lamp glow. A download copy will be exported from source once the model is cleared.

credits.note: KL Rush vehicle art, declared CC0-1.0 in KL Rush’s own records, but modelled on photos of a real production car: design rights unchecked. Made by scripted agents.

The colour, normal and ORM maps every KL Rush car shares, baked from its Rimba SUV. Declared CC0-1.0 in KL Rush’s own records; the Rimba is modelled on photos of a real production car, so design rights are unchecked. Made by scripted agents.
